text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Now is the time for diplomacy for a solution to the Cyprus problem. The S-300 system will come to Cyprus after testing the US initiative for a solution.
- Paphos residents start complaining at delays in the completion of the Paphos-Limassol highway.
- Crisis, what crisis? An agreement has been reached on UN proposals to defuse tension.
- Bosses agree to pay cost of living allowances.
- Industrialists set up their own body to push for concerted action to save industry from disaster.
- President (Glafcos) Clerides agrees to halt arrival of the S-300 missile system for 16 months.
- A high-level Russian intervention on Cyprus is expected, says Communist Akel party chief Demetris Christofias.
- President Clerides's assurances the missiles will not be in Cyprus for the next 16 months propels developments on the issue of banning military overflights.
- The US seeks separate deals with Cyprus and Turkey to ban overflights on the island.
